title: GDPR Compliance Request Letter Template - Exercise Your Rights
metaDescription: Free GDPR compliance request letter template to exercise your data protection rights. Download and customize for access, deletion, or correction requests.
description: Exercise your GDPR rights with our comprehensive request letter template. Perfect for requesting data access, deletion, correction, or portability from any organization processing your personal data under EU regulations.

sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: GDPR Data Subject Rights Request - [REQUEST_TYPE]

Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to exercise my rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) regarding the processing of my personal data by [COMPANY_NAME]. As a data subject, I am entitled to certain rights under Articles 15-22 of the GDPR, and I formally request your assistance in fulfilling this request.

sections.heading: Identification and Account Details
sections.content:
To help you locate my personal data, please find my identification details below:

- Full Name: [YOUR_NAME]
- Email Address: [YOUR_EMAIL]
- Account Number/Customer ID: [ACCOUNT_ID]
- Phone Number: [PHONE_NUMBER]
- Date of Birth: [DATE_OF_BIRTH]
- Any other relevant identifiers: [OTHER_IDENTIFIERS]

I can provide additional verification documents if required to confirm my identity.

sections.heading: Specific GDPR Request
sections.content:
I am hereby exercising my right under Article [ARTICLE_NUMBER] of the GDPR to [SPECIFIC_REQUEST]. Specifically, I request:

[DETAILED_REQUEST]

Please note that under GDPR Article 12, you are required to respond to this request within one month of receipt. If you need additional time due to the complexity of my request, please inform me within the initial one-month period.

placeholders.label: Detailed Request Description
placeholders.defaultValue: Provide a copy of all personal data you process about me

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Compliance Requirements
sections.content:
Please provide information about:

1. The purposes of processing my personal data
2. The categories of personal data you process
3. The recipients or categories of recipients of my data
4. The retention period for my personal data
5. The source of my personal data if not collected directly from me
6. The existence of automated decision-making, including profiling
7. Your legal basis for processing under Article 6 GDPR

If you transfer my data outside the EU, please specify the safeguards in place.

sections.heading: Preferred Response Method
sections.content:
Please respond to this request via [PREFERRED_METHOD]. If providing data electronically, I prefer to receive it in a commonly used, machine-readable format as specified in Article 20 of the GDPR.

For your records, I am using Incognito Browser to protect my privacy while researching my data rights and submitting this request.

sections.heading: Closing and Signature
sections.content:
I look forward to your prompt response within the statutory timeframe. Should you require any additional information to process this request, please contact me using the details provided above.

If you fail to respond within the required timeframe or refuse my request without valid legal grounds, please be advised that I may file a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

useCases: Requesting access to personal data held by companies
Asking for deletion of personal data (right to be forgotten)
Requesting correction of inaccurate personal information
Obtaining data portability to transfer information to another service
Objecting to direct marketing or profiling activities
Exercising rights after a data breach notification
